lines: His snaps rose to 53% over the last 3 games, up from 44% on the season, and targets went from 1.9 to 2.7 a game.

The coach said snaps will likely shrink when Bryant returns. Pittsburgh allows the 21st-most PPR points per game to WRs, and our Wk 12 projection is 3.4 PPR.
